description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects the keepalive matrix-suffix form on master user REST operations.
affected_versions: PaperCut NG: 22.0.5 (Build 63914); verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects the keepalive matrix-suffix form on master user REST operations.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate clients intentionally relying on that noncanonical suffix are denied.
